num_linehaul_customers: <int> Number of linehaul customers requiring goods delivered from the depot.
num_backhaul_customers: <int> Number of backhaul customers with goods to be picked up and returned to the depot.
num_total_customers: <int> Total number of customers (linehaul plus backhaul).
num_vehicles: <int> Number of identical vehicles available in the fleet.
vehicle_capacity: <int> Maximum carrying capacity of each vehicle.
min_vehicles_linehaul: <int> Minimum number of vehicles needed to serve all linehaul customers, determined by bin packing.
min_vehicles_backhaul: <int> Minimum number of vehicles needed to serve all backhaul customers, determined by bin packing.

depot.index: <int> Index of the depot in the distance matrix.
depot.coordinates: <list[int], length 2> X and Y position of the depot on the grid.

linehaul_customers.index: <int> Index of this linehaul customer in the distance matrix.
linehaul_customers.coordinates: <list[int], length 2> X and Y position of this linehaul customer on the grid.
linehaul_customers.demand: <int> Quantity of goods to be delivered from the depot to this linehaul customer.

backhaul_customers.index: <int> Index of this backhaul customer in the distance matrix.
backhaul_customers.coordinates: <list[int], length 2> X and Y position of this backhaul customer on the grid.
backhaul_customers.demand: <int> Quantity of goods to be picked up from this backhaul customer and returned to the depot.

distance_matrix: <list[list[int]], shape [num_total_customers+1][num_total_customers+1]> Travel cost between each pair of locations, where row 0 and column 0 correspond to the depot.

constraints.linehaul_before_backhaul: <bool> Whether all linehaul customers on a route must be served before any backhaul customer on that route.
constraints.backhaul_only_routes_allowed: <bool> Whether routes serving only backhaul customers with no linehaul customers are permitted.
constraints.separate_capacity_for_linehaul_and_backh: <bool> Whether linehaul and backhaul loads are checked independently against the vehicle capacity.
constraints.each_customer_visited_exactly_once: <bool> Whether every customer must appear on exactly one route.
constraints.each_route_starts_and_ends_at_depot: <bool> Whether every route must begin and end at the depot.
